annotations.text:
Sample stories, written to look like a real edition.
Real editions are generated from the configured sources — every field shown here is one the engine actually produces.

The reference is photo-driven; this engine stores no images and the HTML must stay self-contained.
So the hero photograph becomes a filled blue 'Why it matters' block, and the teaser thumbnails become numbered blocks.
System font stack on purpose: the shipped HTML may not load external assets, so a webfont would look right here and wrong in the product.
